feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. The Integrator kept the Iteration 1 controller exactly (kp 2.5, ki 0, kd 0.30, base_speed 1.5, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], last_direction), because no later change beat it. Iteration 1 is still the reference at 114.39. The Integrator had to make no new compensations for this geometry, since it is the same as Iteration 1. Integration point: the remaining off-track endings come from single excursions at bends (max_error 0.061 to 0.068 m against the 0.06 m floor, with rms_error 0.023 to 0.031 m), and that is a controller response issue, not a geometry one. Iterations 4, 9 and 10 show that more or less responsiveness from mass or drivetrain lowers the score. Iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.09) is the closest alternative, at 113.36. Change the next design by what the race shows. If this design races at about 114 again, the result is confirmed and no change is needed. If the score falls, the most likely cause is measurement variance, so keep the geometry and do not retune.
requested_changes: Only if a further design is still to be raced after this one: try wheel_track 0.09 m with all else equal. Iteration 8 gave 113.36 with oval steering_oscillation 0.251 (against 0.282 at 0.10 m) and oval progress 0.456, which is close to Iteration 1.
